notes: Source: Mattel Intellivision Master Component Owner's Manual (1978, Mattel, AU; archive.org Master_Component_Owners_Manual_1978_Mattel_AU), section «THE HAND CONTROLLERS». Quotes are verbatim lines of archive.org's OCR text (the item's _djvu.txt) of the maker's scanned manual, OCR errors and spacing included; the scan, not the OCR, is the authority, and a human should re-read each line against the page image. Mapping: «12 keys on its keypad» = keypad_key 12; «2 action keys on each side» = side_button 4 (two per side; the manual adds that the two top keys share one function); the 16-point direction disc = disc 1 (the manual: «underneath it are 16 points — 16 points on a compass»); the overlay slot at the top of the keypad is noted, not a control. The section is read as the hand controller's complete control list. ports: the coiled cable that attaches the controller to the Master Component = cable 1 (hardwired, so wired=true); no other connector. Body dimensions, mass, cable length: no maker or museum figure found (the Computer History Museum record 102674783 measures the boxed console set only), null.
